name: TON forgets, TONR keeps: 5 seconds of Run

tags.name: Run
tags.comment: a push button: the input of both timers

tags.name: Clear
tags.comment: a push button: the TONR's reset (R)

tags.name: TonDone
tags.comment: a lamp: the TON is done

tags.name: TonrDone
tags.comment: a lamp: the TONR is done

tags.name: T1
tags.comment: an on-delay timer, preset 5 s: forgets when Run goes off

tags.name: T2
tags.comment: a retentive timer, preset 5 s: keeps its time until Clear

rungs.comment: T1, a TON: Run must be held 5 s in one go. Let go and its ET goes back to 0.
T2, a TONR: the time Run is held is added up over every press. Only Clear (in R) sets it back to 0.
TonrDone lights when T2 has 5 s in all, and stays lit until Clear.
